# Requirements Analysis Skill

## Purpose

Convert a user story or source document into clear, testable requirements.

## Process

1. Read the provided user story and existing authoritative requirements.
2. Identify actors and stakeholders.
3. Identify functional requirements, non-functional requirements, inputs, outputs, business rules, dependencies, and edge cases.
4. Identify missing or ambiguous information and ask clarification questions before finalizing requirements.
5. Preserve source terminology and distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions and approved decisions.
6. Mark unavailable information as `Not Found`.
7. Ensure every requirement is testable and traceable to its source.

## Output

Update the repository-root `requirements.md` with the user story, functional and non-functional requirements, business rules, inputs, outputs, error scenarios, assumptions, open questions, and acceptance criteria.
